atom_index_basis: task-canonical heavy-atom order (index 9 = OAV, 10 = CBA, 18 = N3)
probe_method: rigid outward-vector probe at 2.5 and 3.5 A from the heavy-atom neighbour centroid; receptor heavy atoms only; reports geometry, not a free-energy verdict
protection_semantics: A protected site is still enumerated and auditable; the host rejects every operation on it. Atomic clearance is evidence, not a free-energy verdict.
input_contract: The host supplies this site list and the fragment catalog. The designer chooses which fragment goes to which site. This file never names a fragment.
symmetry_convention: Atoms with the same symmetry_class are interchangeable: attaching the same fragment to any of them yields the identical molecule. canonical_atom_index names the representative the host uses, and equivalent_to points a redundant atom at it. A designer may name any member; the host canonicalises the choice instead of failing it.
